personalApproach.title: Personal Approach
personalApproach.description: I work closely with you to understand exactly what you, and more importantly, your customers need. No standard templates, but a website that perfectly fits your business.

focusResults.title: Focus on Results
focusResults.description: You won't just get a beautiful website, but an effective tool that attracts customers.

technicalExpertise.title: Technical Expertise
technicalExpertise.description: With years of experience in web development, I ensure a fast, secure, and user-friendly website that works perfectly on all devices.

hero.title: Hey, I'm
hero.name: Sab
hero.subtitle: As a web developer, I help entrepreneurs take their online presence to the next level.

2023.title: Bachelor Computer Science
2023.description: In 2023, I started my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at Utrecht University. Here I developed a strong foundation in software development, UX design, and AI — knowledge I apply daily in my work as a web developer.

2024.title: First Major Project
2024.description: In 2024, I started developing my own websites. I began with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Later, I experimented with many frameworks, after which I specialized in React. Currently, I work mainly with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS — tools with which I build fast and scalable websites.

now.title: Where I Am Now
now.description: As a freelance developer, I build both websites and apps. I help clients with custom-made websites, and also work on my own SaaS products and apps within the Apple ecosystem, such as iOS and macOS apps. In all my projects, I combine technical knowledge with an eye for design and user-friendliness.

quality.title: Quality Above All
quality.description: I believe in delivering high-quality websites that are not only beautiful but also function perfectly.

attention.title: Personal Attention
attention.description: Every project gets my full attention. By working closely together and regularly checking in, I ensure that the end result perfectly matches my clients' wishes and needs.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: I believe in open communication and transparency. I give you a clear overview of the work I'm doing for you and constantly update you on your project's progress. We'll also always agree on costs in advance.

cta.title: Ready to work together?
cta.subtitle: Let's build your ideal website together.

cta.title: Feeling inspired?
cta.subtitle: Let's turn your ideas into a beautiful website together.

hero.title: Transparent pricing for your website
hero.subtitle: Website costs are difficult to determine in advance, as unexpected problems or adjustments can always occur. However, once the project is clear, we can make an estimate that works for both of us. Below you'll find an overview of what you can expect.

cards.title: Price Indications

landing.title: Landing Page
landing.description: Perfect for promoting a product, service, or event.

business.title: Business Website
business.description: A professional website for your business or portfolio.

shop.title: E-commerce
shop.description: Sell online with a professional e-commerce solution.

cards.disclaimer: These are indicative prices. Exact costs depend on your specific requirements. Contact me for a non-binding custom quote.

design.title: Design Complexity
design.description: Custom designs, animations, and interactive elements require more development time. A unique design sets you apart from the competition.

pages.title: Number of Pages
pages.description: More pages means more content to structure and optimize. Each page is carefully designed for the best user experience.

features.title: Functionality
features.description: Custom features like e-commerce or user accounts require additional development. These make your website more powerful and versatile.

cms.title: Content Management
cms.description: A CMS makes it easy to manage content yourself. The initial setup ensures long-term ease of use.

hiddenCosts.question: Are there hidden costs?
hiddenCosts.answer: No, before I build your website, we discuss all costs. If certain modifications don't fit the budget anymore, we'll look together at what's possible to keep the project within budget. Hosting and domain registration are separate annual or monthly costs that we communicate transparently.

maintenance.question: What about maintenance?
maintenance.answer: I offer optional maintenance contracts for updates, backups, and technical support. We'll discuss this after your website is delivered.

expansion.question: Can I expand my website later?
expansion.answer: Yes, I build your website to be easily expandable. We can always add new functionality as your business grows.
